places.summary_zh:
這個瀑布，季節限定，一但北邊下雪，這瀑布就無法進來，且前面是 3 位數的路，一小段 F 路，路小，冬天常封路，山區有段訊號不好，所以能來的機會不多。

如果能來，這瀑布非常值得一來，瀑布拍起來就像新娘婚紗一樣的美。

停車場旁邊有廁所，步行到瀑布約 20 分鐘，有點不好走要小心，但瀑布非常壯觀，水色很漂亮，我個人是蠻推薦，時間許可以規畫前來
places.summary_en: This waterfall is seasonal; it becomes inaccessible when it snows in the north, and the approach includes a narrow three‑digit road followed by a short, tight F‑road that is often closed in winter. Signal can be weak in the mountainous area, so visits are limited. If you can get there, the waterfall is well worth it, resembling a bridal veil. Parking is available free of charge, and a restroom is next to the parking lot. It takes about a 20‑minute walk to the waterfall, which can be a bit challenging, so proceed with caution. The waterfall is spectacular with beautiful water colors, and a 90‑minute stay is recommended for planning your visit.

places.summary_zh: 位於黑教堂旁邊的高山瀑布，這是一個位於高處的瀑布，近看還不錯，如果腳力不錯的話，可以走到上方，位於瀑布底下看非常壯觀
places.summary_en: Free parking is available nearby, but there are no restroom facilities. The waterfall is located near the Black Church on the Snæfellsnes Peninsula; a short hike up to the top is possible if you have good stamina. Plan for about 30 minutes to enjoy the view, and be prepared for a steep walk to reach the upper viewpoint.

places.summary_zh: 離開金圈後，非常值得一來的地方，裡面有停車場，請尋找 “Brúarfoss Parking” 是新建的停車場，曾經是「秘境」，是一個不容易前來的瀑布，而現在已經有了停車場, 路有點小，且這段路並不好開，路上有碎石要小心，但卻省下大把的時間，非常漂亮，有特色的瀑布。
places.summary_en: After leaving the Golden Circle, this spot is well worth a visit. There is a paid parking lot called “Brúarfoss Parking,” newly built near the waterfall, which used to be hard to reach. The road is narrow and a bit tricky, with loose stones, so drive carefully, but it saves you a lot of time. The waterfall is very beautiful and distinctive.

places.summary_zh:
前往這瀑布有兩條路線 - 862(西側) 與 864 (東側)，我會比較推薦 864 東側比較好，能步行到瀑布旁邊 (約20-30分)，景觀較好，電影「異形 - 普羅米修斯」場景，就在這瀑布的西側這頭取景。

但是 864 這裡常封路，能到的機會有限，一般人比較常從 862 (西側) 過來，地勢較高，但景觀相對不如 864 東側來的壯觀，但862東側，地勢比較高，從停車場步行過來距離也比較短一點，也需約 20 分鐘，所以前來這裡需要預留多一點時間。
places.summary_en: There are two routes to reach the waterfall: Route 862 (west side) and Route 864 (east side). Route 864 is recommended because it allows a short walk (about 20‑30 minutes) right to the waterfall and offers better scenery; the movie “Prometheus” was filmed on the west side of the waterfall. However, Route 864 is often closed, so access can be limited. Most visitors use Route 862 (west side), which is higher in elevation but the view is not as spectacular as Route 864. From the parking lot on Route 862, the walk to the waterfall is slightly shorter, about 20 minutes, so allow extra time for the visit.

places.summary_zh:
冰沙灘，這裡也有停車場，與冰河湖旁邊冰河湖的停車場是「同一個單位」一邊付錢後，兩邊都可以停，步行到冰河湖約 15 分鐘。

這裡有兩個出海口，不一定哪邊有碎冰，只能每次去看狀況，再開車、步行前往。
places.summary_en: Diamond Beach offers a parking lot that shares payment with the nearby glacier lake parking; after paying once, you can park at both sites. It’s about a 15‑minute walk to the glacier lake. There are two sea entrances, and ice conditions vary, so check the situation each visit before driving or walking there.

places.summary_zh: 這是一個由火山噴發物，形成的奇怪岩石地質公園，裡面很大，團體最好一起行動，因為裡面的指示並不是很清楚，且四處長的景像都很像，如果不是團體行動，走失的朋友可能不容易找到出口。
places.summary_en: This is a volcanic rock formation park created by volcanic eruptions, featuring strange and extensive geology. It is best visited with a group, as the signage inside is unclear and many sights look similar, making it easy to get lost if you are alone. Parking is available on-site (paid), and restrooms are also available (paid). Recommended stay is about 60 minutes. Travelers should stay together and be prepared for limited directional guidance.

places.summary_zh: 久帕隆沙灘以黑色卵石、奇岩、古老舉重石及漁船殘骸聞名，這裡曾經有過漁港，如今只在沙灘上見當年沉船的殘骸，這沙灘沙石碎小的碎石，也有漂亮的海灘風景，有時間的話不妨規畫裡來。
places.summary_en: Free parking is available near the beach, and there is a viewpoint for scenic views. The site offers no restroom facilities, so plan accordingly. Allow about 60 minutes to explore the black pebble beach, its unique rock formations, lifting stones, and the remnants of the old fishing harbor.

places.name_zh: 德朗斯坡地第2號的岩石
places.summary_zh: 離開史科嘉瀑布，他就在路口旁邊，可以臨停在路口，大概只能停 3 台車左右，空間不大，停好車後步行到這裡，這裡保留了冰島最古老的茅草屋的原形。
places.summary_en: Leave Skogafoss waterfall; the site is right beside the intersection. You can park briefly at the intersection—there’s space for about three cars only. After parking, walk to the location, which preserves the original shape of Iceland’s oldest thatched house.
search_keywords: 德朗斯坡地第2號的岩石

places.summary_zh:
矮人岩壁由排列整齊的柱狀玄武岩構成，其外形可能受到冰河時期末期海浪侵蝕影響，現為受保護的天然紀念物。

從一號公路旁即可進入步道，參觀時間不長；雨天岩面與草地容易濕滑，請留在既有路線並避免攀爬或破壞岩層。
places.summary_en: The Dverghamrar rock formation consists of neatly arranged basalt columns, possibly shaped by glacial meltwater erosion at the end of the Ice Age, and is a protected natural monument. Access the trail from the side of Route 1; the visit is brief. On rainy days the rock surfaces and grass become slippery, so stay on the marked path and avoid climbing or damaging the rocks. Parking is available for free nearby. No restroom facilities are provided. Plan to spend about 30 minutes at the site.

places.summary_zh: 這裡是西峽灣最大的瀑布，主瀑布沿階梯狀岩壁傾瀉約100公尺，停車場旁邊有休息區，廁所，這裡景觀非常的漂亮，建議是花點時間登上瀑布前，值得你花點時間登上來。
places.summary_en: Dynjandi is the largest waterfall in the Westfjords, with the main cascade dropping about 100 m down a stepped rock face. A free parking lot is located right by the site, and there is a rest area and free restroom facilities nearby. The scenery is stunning, and a visit typically takes around an hour, allowing time to walk up to the waterfall and enjoy the view.

places.summary_zh:
這裡有不同的入口，前往不同的地點，其中一個入口需要停車費，但廁所也在這裡，付了停車費，裡面的廁所就不用付錢，但如果去燈塔那頭就不用付費，但也沒廁所。 (2026.05)

這個半島，我覺得早上、傍晚都蠻值得來的，我個人都有來過，到了停車場，往旁邊走會有步道，可以遠看到黑沙灘。

值得花 60 - 90 分鐘來這裡欣賞南部海景。
places.summary_en: There are several entrances leading to different spots. One entrance requires a parking fee and provides a restroom; the fee also covers restroom use. The path to the lighthouse is free of charge but has no restroom. I recommend visiting the peninsula in the morning or evening. After parking, walk along the side trail to reach a viewpoint with views of the black sand beach. Allocate 60–90 minutes to enjoy the southern seascape.

places.summary_zh: 這片苔蘚熔岩原屬於廣大的 Eldhraun，由1783至1784年的拉基火山噴發形成。可從一號公路旁的安全停靠處欣賞，但苔蘚極為脆弱，受損後可能需要數十年以上才能恢復；請留在既有步道與停車區，絕對不要踩踏、觸摸或駕車進入熔岩原。
places.summary_en: This mossy lava field, part of the vast Eldhraun formed by the 1783‑1784 Laki eruption, can be viewed from the safe pull‑over area next to Route 1. The moss is extremely fragile and may take decades to recover if damaged, so stay on the existing trail and parking area; do not step on, touch, or drive onto the lava field. Parking is free, but there are no restroom facilities. Allocate about 60 minutes for the visit.

places.summary_zh:
羽毛河峽谷，非常漂亮，2024 年有新蓋的停車場，也有廁所，但廁所「經常不開放」，要留意一下。

走到最裡面的觀景台，慢慢走大概走 20-30 分鐘就可以抵達

另外，裡面的手機訊號非常差，很容易斷訊 (2026 年後有改善)
places.summary_en: Fjadrargljufur Canyon is a stunning spot with a newly built parking lot (paid) and restroom (free, but often closed, so check ahead). From the parking area, walk about 20‑30 minutes to reach the innermost viewpoint. Note that mobile signal is very weak and may disconnect frequently, although improvements are expected after 2026. Plan to spend around 60 minutes exploring the site.

places.summary_zh:
這個瀑布實在「太低調了」，不注意的話只會經過路過不會停下來，但他旁邊有特別的停車場，步行到瀑布只要 2 分鐘。

這瀑布很矮，要蹲低看，你會發現這瀑布別有意思，很多層次也很美，算是迷你小的瀑布，開車都會經過的景點。
places.summary_en: This low‑key waterfall is easy to miss, but there’s a convenient free parking lot right next to it; it’s only a two‑minute walk to the falls. The waterfall is short and you’ll need to crouch to see it, but its multiple tiers are charming and make for a nice mini‑waterfall experience. Expect to spend about 30 minutes here.

places.summary_zh:
從史科嘉瀑布，旁邊的步道走上，當你走上步到起，步行 20-30 分鐘左右， 你會接連看到 3 個小瀑布，蠻值得一來的。

在這上面，步行 20 分鐘內，你會看到三個瀑布 - 馬渡瀑布、福斯托爾瀑布、石拱瀑布，如果你旅行時間較為彈性，我蠻推薦走上來看看的，你會發現史科嘉瀑布上游是這景觀。
places.summary_en: From the Skógar waterfall, follow the nearby trail upward. After about a 20‑30 minute walk you’ll encounter three small waterfalls in succession, making it well worth a visit. Within the first 20 minutes of walking you’ll see three waterfalls—the Matarfoss, Fosstorfufoss, and Stone Arch waterfall. If you have a flexible schedule, it’s highly recommended to hike up and explore, as you’ll discover that the upstream area of Skógar waterfall offers this scenic view.

places.summary_zh: 蓋爾杜貝格是一道排列整齊的柱狀玄武岩壁，可從附近停車處短程步行觀賞, 這是一片玄武岩的岩壁，蠻寬廣的，視野非常漂亮，經過時不彷來一趟
places.summary_en: Free parking is available nearby, but there are no restroom facilities. The site features well‑aligned basalt column walls that can be admired on a short walk from the parking area. Allocate about 30 minutes to explore the cliffs and enjoy the panoramic views.

places.summary_zh:
如果單純看噴泉，保留至少 30 分鐘，經驗上是「三大發，一小發」，每 10 分鐘噴發一次。

這裡有旅客中心，有餐廳、紀念品店，廁所免費，停車場要付費，旅客中心前有加油站。
places.summary_en: It’s best to visit around midday so you can rest, have a meal, and use the restroom. When you reach the geyser, you’ll see both large and small eruptions; typically there are three large eruptions and one small eruption every ten minutes, so plan to stay by the geyser for at least 30 minutes. A spacious souvenir shop is also available where you can buy many gifts.

places.summary_zh: 格拉尼瀑布位於北河 Norðurá 上，從停車場沿步道短程步行即可抵達觀景台。雨後與冬季路面可能濕滑。
places.summary_en: Park for free at the on‑site parking lot and follow the short trail from there to the viewing platform. The waterfall is located on the Norðurá (Salmon River) in the Northwest region. The path may be slippery after rain or in winter, so wear appropriate footwear. There are no restroom facilities available. Plan to spend about 30 minutes at the site.

places.summary_zh:
車停在塞里雅蘭瀑布，從停車場走過來約 15 分鐘 800 公尺，這裡洞口很小，裡面也很小，通常要排隊，且裡面瀑布太近，會淋的一身溼，要留意一下。

要走進來，洞口很小，需要要踏在溪水上的石頭，防水鞋子是一定要的，裡面洞口小，大概 10 個人就很擠了，想進來一看需要排隊。
places.summary_en: Park at Seljalandsfoss; it’s about a 15‑minute (800 m) walk from the lot. The entrance to Gljúfrabúi is very narrow and the cave inside is small, so queues are common. The waterfall is close enough to get you completely wet, so be prepared. To enter, you’ll need to step on wet stones in the stream, so waterproof shoes are essential. The space fills up quickly—around ten people can make it feel cramped—so expect to wait in line.

places.summary_zh:
這是北邊知名的瀑布，他有東、西兩側，皆可免費停車，建議可以先到西側，旁邊有休息中心，可以用餐，買東西，付費廁所。

這個瀑布有「東、西」兩側，我建議先停在加油站、休息中心這一邊，步行前往觀看後，有時間再從加油站旁的鐵橋，步行到另一側。

無論你停哪一邊，皆可以步行的方式走到對面。
places.summary_en: This well-known northern waterfall has both east and west sides, each offering free parking. I recommend starting at the west side, where there is a rest center with dining options and a paid restroom. Park near the gas station and rest center, then walk to the viewing area. If you have time, you can cross the nearby iron bridge to explore the east side on foot. Regardless of which side you choose, you can easily walk to the opposite side.

places.summary_zh:
這個是蠻有趣的景點，洞穴內僅 1-2 人可下去，裡面是溫泉，由於入口只有 2 個，且非常不易進去，通常都需要在洞口前排隊才能進去。

上方有個大裂縫，建議是早上來，光線能照進洞口內。

此處亦是《冰與火之歌：權力遊戲》的拍攝場景。
places.summary_en: This interesting site is a small geothermal cave that can accommodate only 1‑2 people at a time; entry is through a narrow opening and you’ll usually need to queue before you can go in. The cave has a hot spring, and because there are only two entrance points that are hard to access, it’s best to visit in the morning when sunlight can illuminate the interior through the large crack above. It was also a filming location for Game of Thrones.

places.summary_zh:
前來金圈，建議先去「辛格維爾國家公園」，再到「間歇泉」，用完餐後，再來最後再到黃金瀑布，這樣比較順路。 建議可以下午來，比較能看得到黃金般瀑布的色彩。

他有上、下兩個停車場，兩個都可以到，建議先到上方的停車場，這裡有旅客中心，再步行到下方瀑布觀景台。

旁邊的旅客服務中心，有餐廳、免費廁所，紀念品店，建議保留 2HR 在這裡，如果只是 90 分鐘的話，其實我覺得蠻趕的。
places.summary_en: Visit the Golden Circle first by going to Þingvellir National Park, then the Geysir area, have a meal, and finally head to Gullfoss; this route is the most efficient. It’s best to visit in the afternoon to see the waterfall’s golden hues. There are two parking lots—use the upper lot, which has a visitor center, then walk down to the lower viewing platform. The nearby visitor center offers a restaurant, free restrooms, and a souvenir shop; plan to spend about 2 hours there, as 90 minutes may feel rushed.

places.summary_zh:
停好車，付好停車費，旁邊的廁所非常的新與高級。

從停車場開始，一路上行到瀑布，步行時間約 50 分鐘，這一路上並不難走，但稍徒一點，到後面就比較好走，請保留時間前往。

來回就要 100 分鐘，要衡量你的旅程來規畫，而途中還會經過小角瀑布 Litlanesfoss 是一段路可以看到兩個瀑布。
places.summary_en: Park your car and pay the parking fee; the nearby restroom is modern and upscale. From the parking area, the walk to the waterfall takes about 50 minutes. The path is generally easy, though slightly uneven at first, becoming smoother later—allow enough time. The round‑trip takes roughly 100 minutes, so plan your itinerary accordingly. Along the way you’ll also pass the smaller Litlanesfoss waterfall, offering a view of two falls.

places.summary_zh:
從史科嘉瀑布，旁邊的步道走上，當你走上步到起，步行 20-30 分鐘左右， 你會接連看到 3 個小瀑布，蠻值得一來的。

在這上面，步行 20 分鐘內，你會看到三個瀑布 - 馬渡瀑布、福斯托爾瀑布、石拱瀑布，如果你旅行時間較為彈性，我蠻推薦走上來看看的，你會發現史科嘉瀑布上游是這景觀。
places.summary_en: From the Skógar waterfall, follow the trail beside it; after about a 20‑30 minute walk you’ll encounter three small waterfalls, making it well worth a visit. Within a 20‑minute walk you’ll see three waterfalls—Maðavörfoss, Fossar Þóris, and Stone Arch waterfall. If you have flexible travel time, I highly recommend walking up to see them, as you’ll discover that the upstream area of Skógar waterfall features this scenery.

places.summary_zh: 瀑布從石頭層流出來，造型非常的漂亮，流出的瀑布如天空藍綠色非常漂亮，但有時來可能會遇上泥水漿，加上開進來單趟要近 50 分鐘，可以衡量旅程來規畫。  另外如果上游有下雨，這瀑布的水可能呈現如泥漿的顏色，所以前來這裡要有心裡上預期不理想。  旁邊步行 3 分鐘，還有一個「小孩瀑布 Barnafoss」 可以一起納進來。
places.summary_en: The waterfall emerges from a rocky layer, featuring a striking shape and sky‑blue/green water, though you may sometimes encounter muddy flow. The drive to the site takes about 50 minutes one way, so plan your itinerary accordingly; after rain upstream the water can appear muddy, so manage expectations. Paid parking and a viewing platform are available on site, and a short 3‑minute walk leads to the nearby “Barnafoss” (Children’s Waterfall), which can be added to your visit.

places.summary_zh:
這裡離遊客中心的停車場，約上山步行約 20 分鐘就可抵達，旁邊的旅客中心可以免費上廁所，記得在停車場付費，再往上走就可以走到玄武岩瀑布。

雖然是爬山，但還好，就這一小段而已。

停車場請打這個地點「Skaftafell Parking」
places.summary_en: Parking is paid at the Skaftafell Parking lot near the visitor center; from there, it’s about a 20‑minute uphill walk to the basalt waterfall. The visitor center offers free restroom facilities. Allow roughly 30 minutes for the visit, and enjoy the viewpoint and on‑site amenities such as the parking area, restroom, and a viewing platform.

places.summary_zh:
Hverir 位於Námafjall山腳，可近距離觀看冒煙噴氣孔、沸騰泥漿池及多彩礦物地表。地殼可能薄弱且溫度極高, 這裡濃濃地熱散發出來的氣味，別有特色的地質公園。

停車場不大，出入口分開，離開前記得 Parka 繳費。

這裡不大，只有一條路，保留 60 分鐘時間可以好好的走上一圈。
places.summary_en: Hverir, located at the foot of Námafjall, offers close-up views of smoking fumaroles, boiling mud pots, and colorful mineral surfaces. Parking is limited, paid, and the entrance and exit are separate, so be sure to pay at the parkas before leaving. There are no restroom facilities on site. Allocate about 60 minutes to walk the short trail and fully explore the area. The site is part of the Diamond Circle and can be reached via Route 1 in Northeast Iceland.

places.summary_zh:
一顆站在海上的犀牛，是Vatnsnes半島東岸約15公尺高的海蝕岩，停好車步行約 5 分鐘可到觀景台，旁邊有路可以下去，但要小心很滑，從主要道路開進來約 40-50 分鐘。

停車場這裡沒有廁所，但旁邊開車不遠的位置有一個付費廁所。
places.summary_en: A 15‑meter‑tall sea stack resembling a rhino stands on the coast of the Vatnsnes Peninsula. Park for free and walk about 5 minutes to the viewpoint. A path leads down from the viewpoint, but it is very slippery, so proceed with caution. From the main road, the drive takes roughly 40‑50 minutes. There are no restrooms at the parking area, but a paid restroom is located a short drive away nearby.

places.summary_zh: 冰河湖遊船，約 40 分鐘，可現場買票，停車場是一天的費用，停在冰沙灘也要繳費，藍冰洞集合點也在這裡，旁邊是冰沙灘，步行 15 分可到，這裡有簡餐廳可以用餐。
places.summary_en: The glacier lagoon boat tour lasts about 40 minutes and tickets can be purchased on site. Parking costs a daily fee, and there is also a paid parking area on the ice beach. The blue ice cave meeting point is located here, next to the ice beach, which is a 15‑minute walk away. A small restaurant nearby offers meals.

places.summary_zh:
這個火口湖，很漂亮，門票約 2-300 台幣，最輕鬆登頂的火山口，靠近金圈旁邊，免費的停車場。

克雷里以紅色火山岩壁與藍綠色湖水形成鮮明對比，可沿火山口邊緣環行，也能走步道下到湖畔。現場採付費入場，步道部分路段較陡，雨雪或結冰時容易濕滑，建議穿著防滑鞋並注意強風。

如果要繞一圈，保留約 50 分鐘時間。
places.summary_en: This crater lake is beautiful, with an entrance fee of around NT$200–300. It offers the easiest hike to the crater rim, located near the Golden Circle, and provides free parking. If you want to walk around the rim, allocate about 50 minutes; otherwise, a 30‑minute visit is sufficient. No restroom facilities are available on site.

places.summary_zh:
這是斯奈山半島最重要的景點，山頂形狀就像草帽，也像教堂，因而稱作「教會山」或是「草帽山」

前方有個「教會山瀑布」

2025 年這裡新建了觀景步道，更方便行走。
places.summary_en: Kirkjufell, the most iconic landmark on the Snæfellsnes Peninsula, looks like a hat or a church, giving it the nicknames “Church Mountain” and “Hat Mountain.” A waterfall, Kirkjufell Waterfall, lies just ahead. In 2025 a new viewing trail was opened, making the hike easier. There is a paid parking lot nearby, but no restroom facilities. Plan to spend about an hour exploring the area and enjoy the panoramic views from the lookout.

places.summary_zh: 巨人峽谷由Víðidalsá河切割形成，河水在峽谷入口化為Kolufossar瀑布群，一邊是瀑布，一邊是峽谷，車到景到，是冰島難得同時有峽谷與瀑布的景點，小巧而美，而開過來的路上比較小一點，停車場也較小。
places.summary_en: The Giant Canyon, formed by the Víðidalsá River, features the Kolufossar waterfall series at its entrance, with the waterfall on one side and the canyon on the other. It is a rare Icelandic spot where a canyon and waterfall coexist, offering a compact yet beautiful view. Parking is available for free, though the lot is small, so arrive early. After parking, head to the viewpoint to enjoy the scenery. No restroom facilities are provided on site. Allow about 60 minutes for a visit.

places.summary_zh:
這個瀑布比較少人知道，但我個人蠻推薦的，這裡有點一點像塞里雅蘭瀑布，走到瀑布內側望出去非常漂亮，就在史科嘉瀑布旁邊，非常推薦大家前來。

離開史科嘉瀑布，開車到這裡的停車場，3 分鐘抵達，停車記得付費，下了車步行約 10 分鐘就可抵達瀑布入口。

在停車場旁邊有簡餐廳，可以在這裡用餐，若想上廁所的話，可以問看看是否付費使用。
places.summary_en:
This waterfall is relatively unknown but highly recommended; it resembles Seljalandsfoss, and the view from the inner side of the falls is stunning. It’s located right next to Skógafoss, so it’s definitely worth a visit.

From Skógafoss, drive to the parking lot here, which is about a 3‑minute drive away. Parking is paid. After parking, walk approximately 10 minutes to reach the waterfall entrance.

There’s a small café next to the parking lot where you can have a meal. If you need a restroom, you can ask whether it’s available for a fee.

places.summary_zh:
前往上方的「懸掛瀑布」就會經過的小瀑布，大概自停車場，走上來約 15 分鐘就可以抵達。

這個瀑布本身沒特別的好看，主要是前往前方的「懸掛瀑布」時你會經過，所以不需要為這個瀑布花太多時間停留。

會說建議停留時間 120 分鐘，是假設你會前往更裡面的懸掛瀑布，如果你有去，就要保留 120 分鐘在這兩個瀑布。
places.summary_en: The small waterfall can be reached after about a 15‑minute walk from the parking lot. It isn’t particularly striking on its own, but you’ll pass it on the way to the larger “Hanging Waterfall” ahead, so you don’t need to spend much time here. The suggested 120‑minute stay assumes you’ll also visit the Hanging Waterfall; if you do, allocate the full two hours for both sites.

places.summary_zh: 這裡有個觀景台，車停好步行到這裡，若天氣不錯可以拍到非常漂亮的湖面山景。
places.summary_en: There is an observation deck; after parking, walk to it, and on clear days you can capture stunning lake‑mountain views. Parking is free, there are no toilets, and a 30‑minute visit is recommended.

places.summary_zh:
這個洞穴很特別，從裡頭望出去的景觀不錯，爬點小山丘就能走到，建議下午來，光線才漂亮。

這裡空曠處停車就好，免費。

洛夫薩拉洞穴是一座鄰近迪霍拉里、可眺望南岸景觀的小型天然洞穴。前往洞口需要走過較陡且可能泥濘濕滑的坡面，並非完善規劃的觀光步道；雨雪、強風或地面結冰時不建議勉強攀爬，亦請避免踩踏周圍脆弱植被。
places.summary_en: The cave is unique, offering nice views from inside; a short hike up a small hill leads to it, and it's best visited in the afternoon when the light is beautiful. Parking is available in the open area nearby for free. Loftsala Cave is a small natural cave near Dyrhólaey with a view of the south coast. Access to the entrance requires walking up a relatively steep and possibly muddy or slippery slope, as there is no well‑developed tourist trail. Do not attempt the climb in rain, snow, strong wind, or when the ground is icy, and avoid stepping on the fragile surrounding vegetation.

places.summary_zh: 隆德蘭加爾是矗立於斯奈山半島海岸的兩座火山岩，又稱作「朗格拉格岩石」，也稱作「怪物海岸」，這裡也是火山噴發冷卻凝結而成的石岸，下午來的景色非常的漂亮。
places.summary_en: Free parking is available, but there are no restroom facilities. Plan to spend about 30 minutes here. The site, also known as Londrangar, features striking volcanic basalt columns formed from cooled lava; the view is especially beautiful in the afternoon.

places.summary_zh:
這個瀑布，本身我覺得「還好」，如果你是從下方「冒險王小鎮」步行上來，比較能取得好的位置，但如果你是停旁邊的停車場，位處高處，瀑布的角度比較不好。

從旁邊停車場走過來約 5-10 分鐘就可以看到，由於瀑布較低，要往前走才會看得到。
但是，來這個點並不是單純為了瀑布，而是為了欣賞東峽灣最美的角度，請見下方照片，這就是值得一來的場景。
places.summary_en: The waterfall itself is just okay, but if you hike up from the lower “Adventure King Town” you’ll get a better viewpoint; parking nearby puts you at a higher spot with a less favorable angle. From the parking lot it’s a 5‑10 minute walk to the falls, and because the waterfall is low you need to walk forward to see it. Most visitors come not just for the falls but for the stunning view of East Fjord; see the photo below for the must‑see scenery.

places.summary_zh:
如果你有參加「冰原摩托車」的話，會在這裡集合。

米達爾斯冰原覆蓋著卡特拉火山，周圍可從不同方向欣賞冰川地貌。冰面遍布裂隙，天氣也可能迅速惡化，禁止自行踏上冰川；如要健行、雪地摩托車或參觀冰洞，務必參加合格嚮導帶領的行程，並事先確認天氣與活動狀態。
places.summary_en: If you are joining an “ice field snowmobile” tour, meet here. Myrdalsjokull covers the Katla volcano, and the surrounding glacier landscape can be viewed from various directions. The ice surface is riddled with crevasses and weather can deteriorate quickly, so walking on the glacier is prohibited; for hiking, snowmobiling, or ice‑cave visits, be sure to join a qualified guided tour and check the weather and activity conditions in advance.

places.summary_zh:
這裡是「地熱谷」與「米湖」這座山必經的道路，當你翻過這麼山，靠近米湖這邊，有一個觀景台，別開太快，這裡可以眺望米湖區風。

如果你是從米湖出發，那這觀景台在你右手邊．如果是從地熱谷往米湖過來，他就在對向。
places.summary_en: This viewpoint is on the road between the Geothermal Valley and Mývatn, and after crossing the mountain you’ll find it on the right side of the lake when coming from Mývatn, or opposite when coming from the Geothermal Valley. It offers a clear view of the Mývatn area; drive carefully and take your time to enjoy the scenery. Parking is free on site. No restroom facilities are available. A 30‑minute stop is recommended.

places.summary_zh:
這是俯瞰厄爾夫薩河與周圍平原的簡易觀景點，冬季天氣晴朗、雲量低且極光活動良好時，可作為觀測地點。現場開闊且容易受到強風影響，夜間前往前請確認雲量、道路與停車狀況，並準備保暖防風衣物。

這裡有一觀景台，還算不錯停，沒有光害，晚上追極光找不到地點，這裡可以考慮，唯一缺點是有車流經過。
places.summary_en: There is an observation platform here that is fairly good; it’s free of light pollution, making it a viable spot for watching the aurora at night when other locations are hard to find, though the only downside is passing traffic.

places.summary_zh:
紅沙灘，在陽光下看起來，反射出淡淡的紅光而名，一般旅遊建議是 9 月後關閉，但實際上你要找找入口處，遠處停好車再走進來。

而不同入口處，看到的紅沙灘也不一樣，這裡的廁所不確定，所以先列「無廁所」。
places.summary_en: The Red Sand Beach reflects a subtle red glow in sunlight. Although it’s generally advised to close after September, you’ll need to locate the entrance yourself—park in the free parking area a short distance away and walk in. Different entrances offer slightly different views of the beach. Restroom facilities are uncertain, so treat it as having no toilets. Allocate about 60 minutes for the visit.

places.summary_zh:
這裡停車非常貴，不如其它景點，繳一次錢可停一天，請留意繳費費用，以及停留時間，以及不同停車場，價格時間也不同。

全冰島有非常多的黑沙灘，而維克旁邊這個黑沙灘，是最有名的，而這個黑沙灘沙石非常的特別，像小石子一下光滑。

這個沙灘旁邊有個海蝕洞，往洞口望出去非常漂亮，但要小心漲潮與海浪，這裡也是冰島非常危險的觀光地區。
places.summary_en: Parking is expensive here; a single payment allows a full day of parking, so be aware of the fee and the duration. Expect to spend about 60 minutes at the beach. The black sand is unique and smooth. There is a sea‑cave nearby with great views, but be careful of tide and waves as the area can be dangerous.

places.summary_zh:
這是冰島「少數」在短時間「爬高」的公路，我覺得這段公路，是整個冰島，除了西峽灣之外，最美的一段山路，建議是規畫一個特別的行程，從「埃伊爾斯塔濟」開始出發到「塞濟斯菲厄澤」。

這段路開車要小心，是在短距離爬到非常亮的亮度，基本上是翻過一座山，不下雨、下雪，天氣良好下，都還要開 40 分鐘，若是積雪的話，這段山路開車時要格外小心。
places.summary_en: This road in Iceland is one of the few routes that quickly climbs to high elevations, offering stunning views. It is considered the most beautiful mountain road in Iceland outside of the West Fjords, and we recommend planning a special itinerary starting from Eyjafjallajökull and ending at Seyðisfjörður. Drive carefully on this short, steep stretch, especially in good weather when it takes about 40 minutes; if there is snow, exercise extra caution. There is a free parking area and a viewpoint, but no restroom facilities. Allocate about 60 minutes for the stop.

places.summary_zh:
塞里雅蘭瀑布，除了冬季外，可以步行到瀑布裡面，也稱作「水濂洞瀑布」，記得帶上雨衣。

每年的 10 月中到隔年的 3 月中，往往因為下雪，通往瀑布後方的步道會結冰、封路。

旁邊的「隱士瀑布」也值得一去，單程步行約 800 公尺，10-15  分鐘可以抵達，如果你也想規畫進來的話，那麼這裡建議 保留 2HR 較不會太趕。

前面的「紀念品店」有販賣一些別處沒有的紀念品，記得去那裡看看。
places.summary_en: You can walk behind Seljalandsfoss (also called “Waterfall Cave”) except in winter, so bring a raincoat. From mid‑October to mid‑March the path behind the falls often freezes and is closed due to snow. Nearby “Hidden Waterfall” is worth a visit; it’s about an 800 m (10‑15 min) walk one‑way, and you should allow about 2 hours to see both sites without rushing. There is a paid parking lot, free toilets, a viewing platform, and dining options on site. The souvenir shop sells items you won’t find elsewhere, so be sure to check it out.

places.summary_zh:
可在路邊停好車，步行約 5 分鐘抵達。瀑布位於較低處，可從不同角度觀賞，景色特別，是一處遊客不多的隱藏景點

這瀑布位於低處，停了車要步行一會，才會看得到，而這瀑布可以繞到瀑布觀看，景別特別，是不多人知道的瀑布。
places.summary_en: This waterfall is a hidden gem; you can park by the roadside (free parking) and walk about 5 minutes to reach it. It's small and beautiful, well worth a visit. The waterfall is located at a lower spot, so after parking you’ll need to walk a short distance to see it, and you can also walk around the falls for different views. It’s not widely known, making it a quiet spot to enjoy.

places.summary_zh:
這裡建議至少停留 30 分鐘，如果想看到彩虹的話，建議中午過後來比較好。如果你時間更多的話，比如你有 1 小時以上，建議可以沿著旁邊的步道往上走，上方還有步行步道，再往前走 20 分鐘，可以看到 2-3 個小瀑布，如果你時間有限，至少保留 30 分鐘欣賞這個大瀑布。

旁邊有磨坊瀑布 Kvernufoss，也建議多留 1HR 前往。

旁邊有餐廳，旅館，新的停車場 2025 年啟用，付費後裡面有新的廁所使用。
places.summary_en:
It is recommended to spend at least 30 minutes here; if you want to see a rainbow, it’s best to visit after noon. If you have more time, such as over an hour, you can walk up the nearby trail for about 20 minutes to see 2–3 smaller waterfalls. If you are short on time, allocate at least 30 minutes to admire the main waterfall.

Nearby is Kvernufoss waterfall, which is also worth spending an additional hour to visit.

There are restaurants, hotels, and a new parking lot opening in 2025; the paid parking includes new restroom facilities.

places.summary_zh:
從史科嘉瀑布，旁邊的步道走上，當你走上步到起，步行 20-30 分鐘左右， 你會接連看到 3 個小瀑布，蠻值得一來的。

在這上面，步行 20 分鐘內，你會看到三個瀑布 - 馬渡瀑布、福斯托爾瀑布、石拱瀑布，如果你旅行時間較為彈性，我蠻推薦走上來看看的，你會發現史科嘉瀑布上游是這景觀。

這三個瀑布都離的很近，都蠻值得一看。
places.summary_en: From Skógá waterfall, take the adjacent trail upward. After about 20–30 minutes of walking, you will see three small waterfalls in succession, which are well worth a visit. Within a 20‑minute walk you will encounter the three waterfalls – Mávárfoss, Fósárfoss, and Steinbogafoss. If you have flexible travel time, I highly recommend hiking up to see them; you’ll discover that upstream of Skógá waterfall lies this scenery. All three waterfalls are close together and definitely worth seeing.

places.summary_zh: 史特約納瀑布位於教堂鎮附近，是一座外形優美、容易抵達的小型瀑布，右側的停車場停好車，走過馬路到對面，再走約 3 分鐘就可以抵達這瀑布，就在路邊很方便。
places.summary_en: Stjörnaarfoss is a small, easily accessible waterfall near Kirkjubæjarklaustur. Park in the free parking lot on the right side of the road, cross the street, and walk about three minutes to reach the falls, which are conveniently located right by the roadside.

places.summary_zh:
前往玄武岩峽谷，有兩個地方，這裡標示的地點是「西岸」，西岸這裡開車進來，有休息區，步行到峽谷約 5 分鐘，如果你是到「東岸」，則要步行約 1 小時才能抵達。

此處是玄武岩峽谷 Grund 側的主要入口，從停車場步行約5分鐘即可抵達階梯及觀景平台，但不能由此進入峽谷河床。若想近距離接觸玄武岩柱，需改走Klaustursel東側步道。923號公路部分為碎石路，冬季須先確認路況。

這裡停車場需付費，有簡餐餐廳，也有免費的廁所。
places.summary_en: Travel to the basalt canyon has two access points; this listing shows the west side entrance. Drive to the west side, where a parking lot and a rest area are available (parking is paid, restroom is free). From the parking lot, walk about 5 minutes to reach the stairs and viewpoint; however, you cannot enter the canyon riverbed from here. To get close to the basalt columns, take the Klaustursel trail on the east side. Note that part of Route 923 is a gravel road, and you should check road conditions in winter. If you choose the east side entrance, expect a 1‑hour walk to the canyon. Recommended stay time is around 60 minutes.

places.summary_zh:
這裡是「斯卡夫塔山」旅客中心，旁邊的步道，車停在「Skaftafell Parking」，旁邊有旅客服務中心，要上廁所，用餐，只有這裡才有。

這瀑布，也叫作「玄武岩瀑布」，冰島非常少見的瀑布，走到這裡要花點時間，但我個人蠻推薦的。

從停車場沿著步道，花 20 分鐘上爬，會先經過「小狗瀑布」，經過他後，再往前走約 20-30 分鐘，就可以抵達，這段路前面有一點小坡，但不難走，走到瀑布下非常壯觀。
places.summary_en: This site is the Skaftafell Visitor Center on the southeast side of the park, with a trail nearby. Park at Skaftafell Parking, where there is a visitor service center, restrooms (free), and a restaurant. The waterfall, also called the basalt waterfall, is rare in Iceland and highly recommended. From the parking lot, follow the trail for about 20 minutes to reach the “Dog Waterfall,” then continue for another 20–30 minutes to the main waterfall. The route includes a slight uphill section but is not difficult. Allow roughly 90 minutes for the visit, including time to enjoy the view from the observation platform.

places.summary_zh: https://photos.app.goo.gl/SsW5aqHzTvSKWA9T9
places.summary_en: Systrafoss (修道姊妹瀑布) is located on the southeast coast of Iceland. Free parking is available on site, but there are no restroom facilities, so plan accordingly. The waterfall can be viewed comfortably within about 30 minutes; follow the marked trail from the parking area to the viewing point. Bring water and be prepared for weather changes, as the area is exposed. Use the provided Google Maps link for navigation.

places.summary_zh: 這裡有許多停車場，建議一開始往「P1」停車場，這裡有休息中心，觀景台也在這裡，大裂縫也在這裡，繳費後，一天內可以往不同停車場前進，不同停車場，都是圍繞在這個公園。
places.summary_en: There are several parking lots here. It’s best to start at the P1 parking lot—this is where you’ll find the visitor center, the viewpoints, and the main fissure. Once you’ve paid the parking fee, you can drive to different parking lots within the park during the same day; they’re all located around the park.

places.summary_zh:
西角山，也叫「蝙輻山」，也有人稱作冰島「天空之鏡」，他有多個名稱，西角山以陡峭山峰、黑沙灘與潮濕沙面的倒影聞名，是冰島熱門攝影地點

他其實是「私人景點」，你可以括尋 「Viking Cafe & Guesthouse」，他本身就是簡餐廳、旅館，而這個「山景」，是要付過路費，你才能進入，所以裡面的停車場是「付費 進入」，但外面的…其實也是付費，只是白天老闆比較不會管，晚上就會了。

裡面有兩個停車場，在裡面的「維京人村莊」旁邊有個停車場，可以拍到「天空之鏡」的畫面，另一個停車場比較裡面一點，可以拍出整個「西角山」的整個山形。
places.summary_en: Vestrahorn (also known as Westfjords Vestrahorn) is a private attraction in the Southeast region of Iceland, famous for its steep peaks, black sand beach, and reflective wet sand. Visitors can access the site via a paid parking fee. There are two parking areas: one near the Viking Cafe & Guesthouse (Viking Village) where you can capture the “sky mirror” reflections, and another slightly farther inside that offers a full view of the mountain’s shape. On‑site facilities include a parking lot (paid), free toilets, a viewing platform, and dining options. It is recommended to allocate about 90 minutes for the visit. Note that while the parking fee is required, enforcement may be less strict during the day.

places.summary_zh:
這裡是個「停車場」，曾經有張白色椅子，這裡的景觀非常好，值得開車累時，中間停下來休息。

這是位於一號公路旁的小型停車觀景點，可欣賞荒涼的火山高地與遠方的赫聚布雷茲山。白色椅子屬非正式地標，可能損壞或消失

這裡的景觀非常好，可以看到冰島北邊的山景，從東峽灣往米湖這段路，非常推薦這裡中間停下來欣賞風景。
places.summary_en: This spot is a free parking lot with a former white chair, offering excellent scenery. It's a great place to stop and rest when you're tired from driving. The view is beautiful, overlooking the northern Icelandic mountains along the route from the East Fjords to Mývatn. We recommend parking here for about 30 minutes to enjoy the landscape.

places.summary_zh: 這個洞穴在維克鎮旁邊，開車約 10 分鐘可以到，需要付費才能停車，從洞穴內往外看，就像星際大戰中的 Yoda 大師一樣。
places.summary_en: This cave is located next to Vik town and can be reached by a 10‑minute drive. Parking is available for a fee. From inside the cave, the view resembles Master Yoda from Star Wars. Plan to spend about 30 minutes exploring.

places.summary_zh:
這裡是冰島斯奈山半島重要的漁港，這裡有幾個重要的景觀。 【Músagjá】心型海蝕洞，以及漂亮的拱橋，從停車場往西走到「Arnarstapi Harbour」，單趟約 20-30 分鐘，很值得一來，可以欣賞海岸的美景。

付費廁所在旁邊。
places.summary_en: This important fishing harbor on Iceland’s Snæfellsnes Peninsula features several notable sights, including the heart‑shaped sea cave Músagjá and a beautiful arch bridge. From the free parking lot, walk west toward Arnarstapi Harbour; the one‑way route takes about 20–30 minutes and is well worth it for the coastal scenery. A paid restroom is located nearby. Allocate around 90 minutes to explore the area.

places.summary_zh:
介於「雷克雅維克」與「維克鎮」中間的大城，是非常大的城市。

如果你準備前往維克，想買任何旅途中需要的東西，塞爾福士是最後一個「最大的城市」，維克鎮很小，再往東的大城市，只有東峽灣的 埃伊爾斯塔濟，很遠，所以若有什麼缺的東西，這裡買會是最理想的。
places.summary_en: Selfoss, located between Reykjavík and Vík, is a large town and the last major city before Vík. If you’re heading to Vík and need any supplies for your journey, Selfoss is the ideal place to shop, as Vík is very small and the next larger town eastward, Egilsstaðir, is far away. Parking is free, and there are free restrooms, a gas station, convenience store, and dining options on site. A recommended stop duration is about 120 minutes.

places.summary_zh:
這裡又稱作「童話小鎮」，也是電影「白日夢冒險王」經典的場景，非常漂亮的漁港小鎮，有通往教堂的「彩虹步道」是亮點。

這裡有廁所，免費的，在 googl map 搜尋「Public toilets」。
places.summary_en: This place, also known as "Fairy Tale Town," is a classic filming location from the movie "Daydream Adventure King" and a very beautiful fishing village. A highlight is the "Rainbow Trail" leading to the church. Free public toilets are available; you can find them on Google Maps by searching "Public toilets." Recommended stay time is about 60 minutes.

places.summary_zh:
維克鎮對於觀光客的重要性，遠大過於雷克雅維克，維克鎮雖然小，但行經南部景點，他都是非常舉足輕重的重要性，加油、採買、住宿，這裡都非常的方便。

推薦一到 Vik 就到鎮上的 Krone 檸檬超市，這裡有「餐廳、超商、紀念品站、廁所」，你旅途需要的這裡全都有。
places.summary_en: Vik is far more important to tourists than Reykjavik; although the town is small, it plays a crucial role when traveling through the southern attractions, offering convenient fuel, shopping, and accommodation. The recommended stop is the Krone Lemon supermarket in town, which provides a restaurant, convenience store, souvenir shop, and restrooms—all the essentials you need for your journey. Parking and restroom facilities are free. A suggested stay time is about 90 minutes.

places.summary_zh:
2026 年，休業整修後重新開幕，現名為「大地溫泉 Earth Lagoon)，原名稱為 米湖溫泉 (Myvatn Lagoon).

個人推薦，如果來到米湖，狀況許可，一定要花點時間來泡泡米湖溫泉，價格比藍湖便宜許多，重要是，視野非常好，建議選在黃昏來，還可以搭配夜景觀看。
places.summary_en: I recommend visiting Earth Lagoon (formerly Myvatn Lagoon) after its 2026 renovation. It’s cheaper than the Blue Lagoon and offers spectacular views, especially at sunset, with the option to enjoy night scenery. Free parking and restroom facilities are available on site. Plan to spend about 2 hours there to fully enjoy the experience.

places.summary_zh:
這個行程位於冰島的Skálakot，提供冰島馬的騎乘體驗，適合所有喜好者。地點屬於西南岸，並且設有免費的停車場及廁所，提供便捷的現場設施。

推薦指數為★★，建議遊客停留約120分鐘以充分享受騎馬活動，並拍攝美麗的風景。這裡也是預約冰島馬體驗行程的出發點，為喜愛大自然和動物的人士提供了優質的戶外活動選擇。
places.summary_en: This tour is located in Skálakot on Iceland’s southwest coast and offers horseback riding on Icelandic horses for all visitors. The site provides free parking and free restroom facilities, making it convenient for travelers. It is recommended to spend about 120 minutes to fully enjoy the riding experience and capture the beautiful scenery. This location serves as the starting point for booking Icelandic horse riding tours, offering a high-quality outdoor activity for nature and animal lovers.

places.summary_zh:
這個溫泉我覺得很棒，有很好的視野，同時還有特殊的「冷泉」，是別的溫泉沒有的。

泡溫泉，建議保留 2hr 比較不趕，這是新開的溫泉，設備蠻新的，也是東峽灣、東北部一帶的溫泉可以規畫在旅程裡。
places.summary_en: The hot spring offers great views and a unique “cold spring” that other spas don’t have. It’s a newly opened facility with modern amenities, making it a worthwhile stop in the East Fjord and northeastern Iceland region. Parking is free, and restrooms are also free. We recommend spending about 2 hours (120 minutes) to enjoy the soak without feeling rushed.

places.summary_zh:
這裡是冰島四大極點的極北點，有特色的巨石陣，拍攝極光當作前景十分漂亮，但考慮距離有些遠，除非旅途行程天數夠，不然並非十分推薦前來。

北極巨石陣結合北歐神話、天文與冰島季節光線，如同大型日晷。
places.summary_en: This site marks Iceland's northernmost point among the four extreme poles, featuring a distinctive stone circle that makes for stunning aurora photography, though its remote location means it's not highly recommended unless you have ample travel time. The Arctic stone circle blends Norse mythology, astronomy, and Icelandic seasonal light, functioning like a large sundial.

places.summary_zh: 教堂免費停車，旁邊有加油站，可以休息、加油、用餐、上廁所。
places.summary_en: Free parking is available at the church, and a nearby gas station provides options to rest, refuel, eat, and use the restroom. A 30‑minute visit is recommended.

places.summary_zh:
冰島南岸的胸罩圍欄（Bra Fence）位於霍爾茨湖（Lake Holtsós）附近，介於塞里雅蘭瀑布（Seljalandsfoss）和斯科加瀑布（Skógafoss）之間，靠近Steinahellir洞穴。

這個圍欄自2012年起，吸引了大量遊客和當地人前來參觀並掛上胸罩，成為冰島南部獨特的景點之一。
起源與意義

胸罩圍欄的起源眾說紛紜。一種說法是，某次聚會後，一些人將胸罩掛在圍欄上，之後這一行為逐漸演變成一種傳統。

另一種說法是，圍欄上的胸罩數量逐年增加，成為一種自發的社區藝術表現。
此外，有人認為胸罩圍欄象徵著女性解放和勇氣，成為冰島南部的一個獨特地標。
places.summary_en: Bra Fence, located near Lake Holtsós on Iceland’s South Coast between Seljalandsfoss and Skógafoss and close to the Steinahellir cave, is a quirky roadside attraction where visitors hang bras on a fence. Parking is available for free on site. There are no restroom facilities, so plan accordingly. A visit typically takes about 30 minutes; allow extra time for parking and walking to the fence. Enjoy the unique local art and take photos, but be mindful of the natural environment and respect any posted guidelines.

places.summary_zh:
這是冰島唯一，全黑色的教堂，往返斯奈山半島的路徑一定會經過它。
開過來的路比較小一點，天色暗時要留意一下。
places.summary_en: This is Iceland’s only all‑black church, and the route around the Snæfellsnes Peninsula passes by it. The access road is relatively narrow, so be cautious, especially in low light. Free parking is available on site, but there are no restroom facilities. Plan to spend about an hour visiting.

places.name_zh: 加爾扎爾 BA 64 廢船
places.summary_zh: 這是一個報廢的漁船，停在這兒形成特別的人造藝術，可以登上船看看，但留意危險。
places.summary_en: This site features a decommissioned fishing boat turned into a unique artificial art installation. Visitors can climb aboard to explore, but should be aware of potential hazards. Parking is available for free, and there are no restroom facilities. Plan to spend about 30 minutes here.

places.summary_zh: 「沉重的山」並非山峰，而是位於93號公路Fjarðarheiði山口的戶外藝術裝置，由多座彩色混凝土方柱組成。現場設有路旁停車空間
places.summary_en: Heavier Mountain is an outdoor art installation at the Fjarðarheiði mountain pass on Route 93, consisting of colorful concrete columns. There is free roadside parking available, but no restroom facilities. Plan to spend about 30 minutes exploring the site.

places.summary_zh: 這座建於1903年的白色教堂位於小山丘上，筆直引道與對稱外觀形成「視力檢查表」般的經典構圖
places.summary_en: The white 1903 church on a small hill offers free parking nearby, but there are no restroom facilities; plan for about 30 minutes to visit and enjoy its classic symmetrical architecture.

places.summary_zh:
卡爾夫斯燈塔位於偏遠的Kálfshamarsvík海灣，周圍可欣賞柱狀玄武岩海岸與昔日漁村遺跡。前往途中包含較偏僻的745號道路。

這裡有玄武岩海岩的燈塔，下午的時候來光線最好。
places.summary_en: The basalt sea‑rock lighthouse offers the best lighting in the afternoon. Free parking is available on site, but there are no restroom facilities. A 30‑minute visit is recommended.

places.summary_zh:
這座紀念碑的殘骸原屬於冰島最長的橋樑——斯凱達拉橋（Skeiðará Bridge）。1996 年，格里姆火山（Grímsvötn）爆發，融化了冰蓋下的大量冰塊，引發了史上極其罕見的「冰川洪水」（Jökulhlaup）。高達每秒 5 萬立方米的水量夾雜著巨大的冰山傾瀉而下，最終將鋼製的橋樑如火柴般輕易折斷、扭曲。

當年這段被洪水沖毀的鋼樑被保留在原址，象徵著人類在強大自然力量面前的渺小，也體現了冰島人與變幻莫測的地形共存的韌性。
places.summary_en: Free parking is available at the site, but there are no restroom facilities. Plan to spend about 30 minutes exploring the monument, which marks the remains of the historic Skeiðará Bridge destroyed by the 1996 glacial flood. The monument is located in the Southeast region (coordinates 63.98471378748029, -16.959388332590397); you can use the provided Google Maps link for directions.

places.summary_zh:
從停車場停好車，這裡停車場要付費. 

停好車後你有二種方式進入，其一是步行進，單趟約 50 分鐘，約 4-5 公里，來回就要快 2HR，評估自身行程。

第二種方法搭接駁車前往，約每半小時就會有一班，你可以買來回票，也可以買單程票，上車時付款。

抵達後約停留 30 分鐘。

所以整個旅行時間，取決於你是如何前來沙灘。
places.summary_en: After parking in the paid lot, you have two ways to reach the site. Walk straight from the parking area, which takes about 50 minutes one‑way (4–5 km) – roughly 2 hours round‑trip – so plan your schedule accordingly. Alternatively, take the shuttle that runs every half hour; you can purchase a round‑trip or one‑way ticket and pay on board. Once you arrive, spend around 30 minutes at the wreck. The total travel time depends on which option you choose.
search_keywords: 索爾黑馬桑德飛機殘骸

places.name_zh: 史蒂芬·G·史蒂芬森紀念碑
places.summary_zh:
史蒂芬·G·史蒂芬森紀念碑 是為紀念冰島最受愛戴的詩人之一——Stephan G. Stephansson（1853-1927）而建立的一座雄偉且具有影響力的藝術作品。他是一位重要的詩人，移居到北美，先到威斯康星州，後來到加拿大亞伯達省，在那裡他作為農民和詩人度過了大部分的生命。

地點與設計

紀念碑矗立在冰島北部的 Kirkjuhóll 農場，靠近 Sauðárkrókur 小鎮，這裡是史蒂芬·G·史蒂芬森的出生地。它於 1953年 在詩人誕辰 100 週年時揭幕。
這件作品由冰島藝術家 Ríkarður Jónsson（1888-1972）創作，是他的著名作品之一。它使用 石頭 堆砌而成，在周圍的景觀中非常引人注目。

象徵與意義

這個紀念碑並非傳統的雕像，而是由 三個巨大的石堆 從地面向上伸展。這個造型通常被解讀為以下幾種象徵：
- 詩人與土地和自然的聯繫：史蒂芬·G·史蒂芬森是位農民，大自然是他主要的靈感來源。
- 塑造他生命和詩歌的三種文化交匯：冰島、西方世界（加拿大/美國），特別是旅居西方的冰島人的文化遺產。
- 詩人的精神根源和尊嚴。

其中一塊石頭上刻著詩人的名字，另一塊則刻有他詩歌中的詩句。
places.summary_en: Free parking is available on site, and there is a viewpoint for visitors. No restroom facilities are provided, so plan accordingly. Allocate about 30 minutes for the visit and enjoy the monument and surrounding scenery.
search_keywords: 史蒂芬·G·史蒂芬森紀念碑
史蒂芬史蒂芬森紀念碑

places.summary_zh: 別具造型的教堂，是一座融合了現代主義美學與地景意象的傑出建築。它不僅是當地居民的信仰中心，更是眾多攝影師與建築愛好者造訪冰島時必去的朝聖地。
places.summary_en: The uniquely shaped church blends modernist aesthetics with the surrounding landscape, serving as both a local faith center and a must‑visit pilgrimage site for photographers and architecture enthusiasts visiting Iceland. Parking is available for free on site. There are no restroom facilities, so plan accordingly. Allocate about 30 minutes to explore the interior and exterior. Use the provided Google Maps link for directions.

places.name_zh: 斯沃圖洛夫特黑崖燈塔
places.summary_zh: 如果你要蒐集冰島「四大極點」的話，這就是極西角燈塔，開過來的路，有些不好開，路小且顛，但這裡觀看的視野不錯，如果行程有限，又想觀海的話，這個點不錯。
places.summary_en: If you're collecting Iceland's "four extreme points," this is the westernmost lighthouse. The road leading here is narrow and winding, but the view is excellent. It's a good spot to see the sea, especially if you have limited time.
search_keywords: 斯沃圖洛夫特黑崖燈塔

places.summary_zh:
維濟米里教堂建於1834年，是冰島少數保存至今的草皮教堂，目前仍具有教區教堂功能。內部通常只在夏季特定時段開放，出發前請確認最新時間；參觀時請保持安靜、尊重禮拜活動與建築規範，非開放期間可在外部欣賞。

他就在 1 號公路旁邊，路過可以經過，非常近。
places.summary_en: Vídimyri Turf Church, built in 1834, is one of Iceland’s few remaining turf churches and still functions as a parish church. It is usually open to visitors only during specific summer periods, so check the latest opening times before you go. When visiting, keep quiet, respect any worship activities, and follow the building’s guidelines. If the church is closed, you can still admire the exterior from the roadside. Parking is free nearby, but there are no restroom facilities on site. Plan for about 30 minutes of visiting time.

places.summary_zh: 這棟黃色建築是《白日夢冒險王》中靴子酒吧及直升機起飛場景的拍攝地，實際上並非營業中的酒吧，通常不能入內參觀。適合影迷短暫拍照
places.summary_en: The yellow building serves as the filming location for the boot bar and helicopter take‑off scene in The Secret Life of Walter Mitty. It is not an operating bar and generally cannot be entered. Visitors can stop briefly for photos, park for free nearby, and should allow about 30 minutes for a quick visit. No restroom facilities are available.
